title: Baby Girl Judy at 12 Months in Bonnet, 1955 Home Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot captures a smiling 12-month-old toddler named Judy taking early steps barefoot in a living room. Dressed in a ruffled sunbonnet and romper, she steadies herself next to a bent-bamboo armchair upholstered in a tropical leaf fabric. Sunlight streams in through horizontal blinds behind her, illuminating a tall metal floor lamp and a geometric patterned carpet. The top border carries a faint lab stamp reading 'AUG 55'.
